answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 37808 Country: India Title: When does qasar salah becomes wajib whether it is 38 miles or 40 miles or 48 miles there are difference of opinion Question: When does qasar salah becomes wajib whether it is 38 miles or 40 miles or 48 miles there are difference of opinion? Answer ID: 37808 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 638/638/M=1433) There is no opinion favouring 38 or 40 miles. Regarding the journey distance, there are four opinions in Shami etc: 63, miles, 54 miles, 48 miles, and 45 miles. The majority of the Fiqh scholars preferred 48 miles which at present is 77.25 kilometres. Hence if someone makes intention to set out on a journey of 77.25 km or more from his native place, then qasr is wajib on him. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
